metrics.profile_summary: Results-driven Performance Marketing Manager with 5 years of experience leading paid media strategy across Meta, Google, and TikTok. Expert in the GCC and Southeast Asian markets, managing budgets over $50K/month with a proven track record of delivering ROAS up to 6.5x.

experience.description: Directs paid media strategy and execution for GCC and Southeast Asia clients, managing account architecture, conversion tracking, and budget allocation across Meta, Google, and TikTok.
Managed multi-platform budgets for Dubai-based clients in real estate and e-commerce, achieving 5.3x ROAS and reducing CPL by 34% through bid strategy refinement and SKAG restructuring.
Led Meta Ads for fashion e-commerce, achieving 6.5x ROAS via Advantage+ Shopping, full-funnel retargeting, and rigorous creative testing sprints.
